verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an email-delivery platform, since self-hostable alternatives exist in this category, so the axis applies. The evidence describes SendGrid only as a hosted service: email goes out through SendGrid's servers, cloud connections and regional endpoints. The open-source SDKs are client libraries, not a self-hostable core.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
